coreIdea: Positional value = Σ digit×base^pos. Two's complement: invert+add1, range -2^(n-1) to 2^(n-1)-1 (asymmetric). Overflow only possible with SAME-sign addition, rule = carry-in≠carry-out at sign bit.
mustRememberFormulas: n-bit sign-magnitude range: -(2^(n-1)-1) to 2^(n-1)-1, TWO zero representations

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: convert number between bases, or unknown-base equation
'2's complement representation of X' or 'decode this bit pattern' or range asked

commonTrapsQuickList: Two's complement range is ASYMMETRIC — one more negative value than positive
Overflow needs carry-IN vs carry-OUT comparison at sign bit, not just 'any carry'
Opposite-sign operands can never cause overflow
Sign-extend (replicate sign bit) when widening negative numbers, don't zero-pad
highYieldPyqLessons: Base conversion (18/57) is the single biggest sub-skill — purely mechanical, get it to 100% accuracy fast.
This is the 2nd-highest-PYQ topic in the ENTIRE corpus — disproportionately high-value for time invested given how formulaic it is.
